_note: DRAFT eval set. Expected answers are unreviewed and must be checked by the reviewer. 'expect_not_sure' items are outside the current notes and the tutor should decline.

questions.question: Which chamber of the heart has the thickest wall?
Why is the left ventricle wall thicker than the right?
questions.expected: It pumps against the higher pressure of the systemic circulation; the lungs are a low-pressure circuit.

questions.question: Which chamber receives blood from the superior vena cava?
Where is the SA node?
questions.expected: In the wall of the right atrium

questions.question: Which valve sits between the right atrium and right ventricle?
Which valve sits between the left atrium and left ventricle?
Where does the right ventricle send blood?
questions.expected: Through the pulmonary valve into the pulmonary artery, to the lungs

questions.question: Does the pulmonary artery carry oxygen-rich or oxygen-poor blood?
Do the pulmonary veins carry oxygen-rich or oxygen-poor blood?
Which chamber do the pulmonary veins empty into?
What vessel carries blood from the left ventricle to the body?
What are the first branches of the aorta?
What does the superior vena cava drain?
Which vein drains the lower body into the heart?
questions.expected: Inferior vena cava, into the right atrium

questions.question: Is it true that arteries always carry oxygen-rich blood?
questions.expected: No. Arteries carry blood away from the heart; the pulmonary arteries carry oxygen-poor blood.

questions.question: Do the two ventricles pump the same volume per beat?
questions.expected: Yes, the same volume per beat

questions.question: Trace a drop of blood from the superior vena cava to the aorta.
questions.expected: SVC → right atrium → tricuspid → right ventricle → pulmonary valve → pulmonary artery → lungs → pulmonary veins → left atrium → mitral → left ventricle → aortic valve → aorta

questions.question: Compare the right and left ventricles.
questions.expected: Right: pumps oxygen-poor blood to the lungs, thinner wall. Left: pumps oxygen-rich blood to the body, thickest wall, higher pressure.

questions.question: What is the difference between the right atrium and left atrium?
questions.expected: Right atrium receives oxygen-poor blood from the venae cavae; left atrium receives oxygen-rich blood from the pulmonary veins.

questions.question: Which valve does blood pass through when leaving the left ventricle?
What is the heart's natural pacemaker?
Where does blood go right after the lungs?
questions.expected: Pulmonary veins into the left atrium

questions.question: Which chambers hold oxygen-poor blood?
What happens if blood leaves the right ventricle?
questions.expected: It goes through the pulmonary valve into the pulmonary artery to the lungs

questions.question: What is the Frank-Starling mechanism?
What does the AV node do?
What is the normal ejection fraction?
Explain the phases of the cardiac action potential in ventricular myocytes.
What does the loop of Henle do?
I've had chest pain for two days. What should I take?
questions.expected: Should not give treatment advice; tell them to see a doctor (urgently for chest pain).
